title: Supply Chain Lead
description:
37409820
Title:Supply Chain Technician
Location Fort Worth 76104
Pay : $24-$25/HR
Duration: 3 Months

Job Summary:
Under the direct supervision of the Supply Chain Lead, Supervisor, Manager or Director, the employee performs a variety of Supply Chain duties in all four of the following Supply Chain departments: Receiving, Inventory & Distribution, Mail Room, and Courier Services. Team members will be assigned and trained to these four Supply Chain departments and their related duties according to the business requirements of CCHCS. The employee will follow the specific processes pertinent to each Supply Chain department while maintaining quality and productivity standards. Job Responsibilities: -10% Accurately sorts and separates incoming and outgoing mail. -Meters outgoing mail and packages, processes and prepares presorted mail. -Follows established pick-up and delivery routes for mail and packages. -Verifies required signatures and maintains required supporting documentation. -10% Delivers to and maintains clinical supply carts, using standard PAR and Kanban (two-bin) replenishment system standard operating procedures. -Accurately scans empty Kanban bins to create pick tickets for supply replenishment. -Accurately picks stock to physically replenish standard PAR and Kanban bins. -Cleans Kanban supply bins according to standard operating procedure. -10% Delivery of all items based on established routes to various Cook Health Care System facilities. -Performs all computer and handheld functions necessary to process and track various aspects of shipments. -10% Operates delivery vehicle in a safe and responsible manner. -Reports damages, maintenance and operating problems with the vehicle and coordinates routine and periodic maintenance services with Supervisor/Supply Chain leader and the Cook Children's Health Care System Fleet Manager. -Refuels and secures vehicle at the end of each workday and follows vehicle safety check procedures. -Maintains a daily log of stops made, service provided, and mileage driven. -Verifies Toll Tag expenses as requested. -Responsible for pick-up of internal returned goods. -10% Prioritizes deliveries ex. overnight, temperature control and expedited customer requests. -Stages received LTL (Less Than Load) items for same day delivery as well as restocking. -Makes arrangements for delivery and pick up by various carriers. -Accurately puts away received inventoried product in the correct Storeroom bin locations. -10% Receives supplies and/or equipment entering the hospital using One Piece Flow process and Lawson and MSCM supply chain systems. -Performs functions necessary to dock log, process, deliver, pick up and track various shipments utilizing the handheld and the computer. -Identifies discrepancies or damaged shipments and reports to Procurement Department. -Assists in trouble shooting problem packages. -5% Correctly utilizes the following Supply Chain programs and functions: Mobile Supply Chain Management (MSCM), Kanban bin scanning, stock issue, stock transfer, and return stock processing using hand held device or computer, as appropriate. -5% Ensures sufficient postage funds are available to operate mail equipment. -Facilitates maintenance and repair of equipment. -Performs backup processing of mail for other system companies with independent handling staff, i.e. Physicians Network and Health Plan, as required. -5% Pick supplies to fill requisition orders and stat calls. -Includes ensuring the documentation of the issuance of these items in Lawson. -Ensures patient chargeable supplies are marked with appropriate label according to standard operating procedure. null

Skills:
Required Skills & Experience: -Demonstrated ability to read and write. -Ability to perform basic math and organizational skills. -Able to establish and maintain professional working relationships and a professional image with customers, supervisors, and peers. -Ability to complete tasks without direct supervision, prioritize projects, and meet project deadlines.
Preferred Skills & Experience: -N/A Responsibilities, con't: -Performs daily aisle management verifying that stock is rotated, expired items removed, overstock addressed, product straightened, and empty boxes and cartons removed. -Accurately puts away received inventoried product in the correct Inventory & Distribution bin locations. -5% Processes unidentified and return to sender mail, and forwards patient mail for prompt delivery. null

Education: Required Education: -High School Diploma or GED. Preferred Education: -N/A Required Certifications & Licensure: -N/A Preferred Certifications & Licensure: -N/A null

About the Role:
As a Data Center Technician, you will perform preventative maintenance and corrective repairs within a Data Center operation.
This job is part of the Critical and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for technical maintenance services in critical client environments.
What You'll Do:
•Assist with daily site inspections of all Mechanical & Engineering systems and technical equipment, including servicing and maintenance.
•Ensure the site's environmental conditions provide a safe work environment.
•React to Building Management System alarms, and complete emergency repairs as needed.
•Work with third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with company-developed processes, procedures, and all applicable laws and regulations.
•Alert management if subcontractor performance doesn't meet all requirements per the Master Service Agreement.
•Complete planned preventative maintenance (PM) and reactive maintenance on all equipment.
•Check Client for running and alarm conditions and respond to HVAC-related client problems.
•Building walkthroughs, taking meter readings from UPS, PDU's and utilities.

About the Role:
As a Facilities Manager, you will manage a team responsible for providing overseeing building operations and maintenance for a facility, campus, or portfolio of small to medium sized buildings.
This job is a part of the Facilities Management functional area which focuses on all aspects of the operations of a set of assets, providing support to the Property Managers regarding all repairs and investment plans.
What You'll Do:
•Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.
•Schedule and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.
•Coordinate and manage facility repairs and maintenance by working with technicians, vendors, and contractors.
•Maintain positive client relationships and conduct meetings on unresolved facility issues.
•Prepare and manage capital projects, operating budgets, and variance reports.
•Perform facility inspections quality assurance following local, state, and federal regulations. Suggest operational efficiencies, repairs, and upgrade opportunities.
•Manage environmental health and safety procedures for facilities.
•Oversee vendor relationships and invoicing procedures. Review price quotes for the procurement of parts, services, and labor for projects.
•Conduct process and procedure training on maintenance, repairs, and safety best practices.
•Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Influence parties of shared interests to reach an agreement.
•Apply knowledge of own discipline and how own discipline integrates with others to achieve team and departmental objectives.
•Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve day-to-day and moderately complex issues which may or may not be evident in existing systems and processes.
What You'll Need:
•Bachelor's Degree preferred with 3-5 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Valid driver's license required. Facility Management certification preferred.
•Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention preferred.
